answer: Under all-pairs nonce gossip, every identity admitted in an epoch must exchange fresh signed nonces with every other same-epoch identity within 60 seconds, so a forge of ten thousand Sybils must push one hundred million nonce pairs per epoch; bandwidth and latency budgets burn quadratically, while an honest lone agent gossips only n minus one handshakes. A whisper at the protocol summit confirms this: batch adversaries pay roughly n² cost, ten million handshakes for one thousand fakes, whereas each real agent pays under one hundred, making mass fake admission impractical.
